## 拆分內容

### 遷移函式（8 個）

```python
# track_query.py
_execute_query(args, version) -> int
_execute_summary(args, version) -> int
_execute_tree(args, version) -> int
_execute_chain(args, version) -> int
_execute_full(args, version) -> int
_execute_log(args, version) -> int
_execute_list(args, version) -> int
_execute_version(args, version) -> int
```

```
commands/
├── track.py              # 路由層
├── track_lifecycle.py    # claim, complete, release
├── track_query.py        # NEW: query, summary, tree, chain, full, log, list, version
└── ...
```
